newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez,Lyonnaise to discuss merger April 11.
newsitem.headline: Suez,Lyonnaise to discuss merger April 11.

text.p: French holding company Cie de Suez and utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Friday the boards of both companies would hold special meetings on April 11 to discuss a merger plan.
Officials at both companies declined any further comment on the merger plan, confirmed for the first time on Friday after more than a week of intense stock market speculation.

"The boards of Cie de Suez and Lyonnaise des Eaux will approve, as planned, their accounts for 1996, during a meeting at Suez on April 1 and at Lyonnaise des Eaux on April 2," the two companies said in a brief statement.
"The boards will be then called to special meetings, on Friday April 11, 1997, to discuss a merger project between the two companies," the statement said.
